所附照片之人已确认为康斯坦丁·列昂季耶维奇·伊万诺夫（Constantine Leontievich IVANOFF），别名埃文斯（EVANS），35岁，俄国人。此人已有犯罪记录，详情如下：-

罪行。    判决    判决日期

盗窃罪    撤销起诉    1927年3月24日

盗窃罪    判处有期徒刑一年，缓刑两年    1928年10月20日

致爪哇岛巴达维亚警察局长。

曼谷，1937年9月23日。

先生：

兹通知阁下，所附照片即为上海警方通缉的C.L.伊万诺夫（C.L.Ivanoff）。上海公共租界工部局警务处的格洛弗 (Glover) 巡官已为逮捕伊万诺夫提供赏金，因为此人是一名扒手、骗子和抢劫犯，目前还试图通过展示他声称能制造的假币来诈骗民众。据我了解，他即将与两名葡萄牙助手一同前往爪哇。
此外，这名伊万诺夫是一名俄国布尔什维克，他持伪造的拉脱维亚护照旅行，上海警方的格洛弗巡官可以证明上述所有陈述属实。

您诚挚的，

一名受此职业罪犯侵害的受害者。

相符副本认证：
首席检察官办公室主管，

（签名） ____ M.

        With reference to the letter of this Consulate General of
February 9, 1938 No.392 and your reply of February 12, 1938
No.D.8346 with regard to Vladimir Ilyich Malkoff, I have the
honour to inform you that the authorities at Batavia have con-
fiscated two letters received from Bangkok and addressed to Mr.
G.Krupp, Poste Restante, Batavia.  The sender gave his address
as Mr.Chanon - Poste Restante Bangkok, and informed Krupp
(Malkoff) that he intended to travel to Penang,where he would
deposit his secret address in a letter addressed to Krupp, Poste
Restante at Penang.
        Investigations made at Penang by the British authorities
have established that the person in question is Constantine
Leo Ivanoff alias Evans, who was residing at Penang, International
Hotel, 7 Peith street, on the 9th January 1938.
        Ivanoff appears to be wellknown to the Hong Kong Police in
connection with a case of fraud.
        In the course of 1937 the Police at Batavia received an
anonymous letter a copy of which is enclosed herewith together
with a copy of a photograph.
        I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know
whether this person is Ivanoff and whether anything is known
against him.
        I request you kindly to have the photograph returned to me
in due time.

                                                I have the honour to be,
                                                        Sir,
                                                Your obedient servant,

D.S.D. Dohghiev.
C. 1/5.                                 （签名）
                                        Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. 8346
Section 1, Special Branch    SH/SH/
REPORT
Date February 11, 1938

Subject Communication dated 9-2-38 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning V.I. Malkoff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Gaspard D.I.

The person whose photographs and fingerprints are at-
tached herewith has been identified as Vladimir Ilyich MALKOFF
who is known to have been residing in Shanghai for various peri-
ods prior to 1932.

From the particulars he gave when registering at the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, in September,
1930 it appears that he is a Russian who was born on November 21,
1911 at Blagoveschensk, Siberia. Shortly prior to the occupation
of Vladivostok by the "Reds" in November, 1922 he left that city
together with his mother and elder brother for Harbin and in
1923 proceeded to Shanghai in order to re-enter the Habarovsk Mi-
litary Cadets School which had been evacuated from Valdivostok
to Shanghai towards the end of 1922. Following the departure of
the school for Jugoslavia in 1924, he left for Harbin. Returning
to Shanghai in 1926 he attended the Thomas Hanbury School until
1928, after which he again left for Harbin, where he claims to
have been employed for some time with Walter Eshig & Co., a Ger-
man firm, as an office clerk. On 28-9-30 he arrived in Shanghai
and resided in this city for the following two years or so, after
which he is reported to have left for Canton.

He first came to the notice of the Shanghai Municipal
Police on October 21, 1931, when he was sentenced by the 2nd S.S.D.
Court to 30 days imprisonment on a charge of larceny.

In February, 1934 he was arrested by the Police of the
International Settlement of Kulangsu, Amoy, on a charge of larceny.
The circumstances of this case may present an interest in connec-
tion with the present enquiries:-

It appears from the communication from the Kulangsu

主题 荷兰总领事馆1938年2月9日来函，涉及V.I. 马尔科夫。

撰写人：高级巡官普罗科菲耶夫 (Prokofiev)。    转呈人：首席巡官加斯帕德 (Gaspard)。

所附照片和指纹之人已确认为弗拉基米尔·伊里奇·马尔科夫（Vladimir Ilyich MALKOFF），据悉他在1932年之前曾断断续续居住在上海。

根据他1930年9月在莫尔缅路 (Moulmein Road) 118/1号俄国侨民委员会登记时提供的资料，他是一名俄国人，1911年11月21日出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克 (Blagoveschensk)。在1922年11月“赤色分子”占领符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）前不久，他与母亲和兄长离开该市前往哈尔滨，并于1923年前往上海，以便重新进入已于1922年底从符拉迪沃斯托克撤离至上海的哈巴罗夫斯克军校学员学校。1924年该校迁往南斯拉夫后，他前往哈尔滨。1926年回到上海后，他就读于汉璧礼西童公学 (Thomas Hanbury School) 直至1928年，之后再次前往哈尔滨，据称他在那里曾在一家德国公司沃尔特·埃希格公司 (Walter Eshig & Co.) 担任职员一段时间。1930年9月28日他抵达上海，并在该市居住了约两年，此后据报道他前往广州。

他首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处注意是在1931年10月21日，当时他因盗窃罪被第二特区地方法院判处监禁30天。

1934年2月，他因盗窃罪被厦门鼓浪屿公共租界警方逮捕。此案的情节可能与目前的调查有关，具体如下：-

根据鼓浪屿警方的来函显示

Police that Malkoff, in company with another individual with a cri-
minal record, used to enter foreign houses on various pretexts.
After one of such visits jewelry valued at $ 1400 was found to
have been stolen from the house concerned, and an hour later the
two men were arrested on board of a steamer due to sail for Swa-
tow. Their possessions consisted of two small bundles of clothing
of little or no actual value. Letters found on them would indi-
cate that many articles have been forwarded from Canton, their
headquarters at that time, for sale to Harbin. On account of the
fact that the missing jewelry could not be located, the Court did
not consider the evidence sufficient to convict. However, both
men were sentenced on 16-3-34 to 14 days imprisonment for tres-
pass with intent to commit a felony.

    His brother, Alexander Ilyich Malkoff, has been in
the employ of the Shanghai Municipal Police for over 4 years and
since 1935 has been attached to the Communication Control Room.

    The amateur radio station XU 8 RB mentioned in the
communication in question is the property of a friend of A. Mal-
koff who experiments on a set made by himself. It appears that
A. Malkoff, for the purpose of testing this set, endeavoured to use
it in communicating with his brother .

    There is no record in the Municipal Police of any
person named G.A.Krupp, W.Beck, M.Bining or Schoers. It is pos-
sible that the latter name is a misspelt version of "Shura" ( or
Schura, Schoora, Schoura) -an intimate name given to those called
Alexander by Russians. It would be quite natural for Alexander
Malkoff to sign in this manner letters which he addresses to his
brother.                                C. Prokopjew

警方称，马尔科夫曾与另一名有犯罪记录的人结伴，以各种借口进入外籍人士住宅。在一次此类拜访后，发现涉案住宅内价值1400美元的珠宝被盗，一小时后，这两人在一艘即将驶往汕头的轮船上被捕。他们的随身物品仅包括两小包实际价值极低或毫无价值的衣物。在他们身上发现的信件表明，许多物品已从他们当时的总部广州发出，运往哈尔滨销售。由于失踪的珠宝未能找到，法院认为证据不足以定罪。然而，两人均于1934年3月16日因意图犯重罪而非法侵入被判处监禁14天。

    他的兄弟亚历山大·伊里奇·马尔科夫 (Alexander Ilyich Malkoff) 已在上海公共租界工部局警务处任职四年多，自1935年起隶属于通讯监控室。

    前述信函中提到的业余无线电台 XU 8 RB 属于A. 马尔科夫的一位朋友，该朋友使用自己制作的设备进行实验。看来A. 马尔科夫为了测试这套设备，试图用它与其兄弟进行通讯。

    工部局警务处没有名为G.A.克鲁普 (G.A.Krupp)、W.贝克 (W.Beck)、M.比宁 (M.Bining) 或舍尔斯 (Schoers) 的任何人的记录。后一个名字可能是“舒拉” (Shura)（或Schura, Schoora, Schoura）的拼写错误——这是俄国人对名叫亚历山大的人的亲昵称呼。亚历山大·马尔科夫在给兄弟的信中以这种方式署名是很自然的。                                C. 普罗科皮耶夫 (Prokopjew)

CONFIDENTIAL

No.392. SHANGHAI, 9th February 1938. S1
Ear-17
mB
FEB 1038

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that on January 20, 1938
at Batavia was arrested GENRICH ANATOLE KRUPP, alias WLADYSLAW
BECK, alias MICHEL BINING, alias VLADIMIR ILICH MALKOFF.

The person in question was arrested for a theft of diamonds
at Semarang on the 19th January 1938.

He was in possession of two passports (Polish and Czechoslo-
vakian), which according to his statement are false.

During his trial he revealed that his real name was VLADIMIR
ILICH MALKOFF, 25 years of age, born at Blagoveschensk (Siberia)
on August 5, 1912. He arrived at Harbin from Vladivostock in
1921, together with his mother and brother.

From 1922 till 1931 he stayed at Harbin and Shanghai and went
afterwards to Canton.

In 1933 or 1934 he was arrested by the Police at Hong Kong
for small shopthefts and was expelled from Hong Kong for a period
of ten years.

From one of the letters confiscated by the Police at the
Postoffice at Batavia it appears that he received mail from a per-
son at Shanghai named Schoers. According to the statement of
"Malkoff" this is his brother who is connected with the Police at
Shanghai. In this letter is mentioned that Schoers regularly vi-
sits an amateur Radio Station XU 8 RB and that he request his
brother to get in touch with a radio amateur at Java in order to
be able to communicate with each other.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know
whether the persons mentioned in this letter ever came to the
notice of the Police at Shanghai.

|| Two photographs and one card with fingerprints from Malkoff
are enclosed with the request to have them returned to me in due time.
I have the honour to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI. D. S. J. Gndefin
C. 1/2. Acting Consul-General.

谨此通知阁下，1938年1月20日，GENRICH ANATOLE KRUPP（别名：WLADYSLAW BECK，别名：MICHEL BINING，别名：VLADIMIR ILICH MALKOFF）在巴达维亚被捕。

此人因涉嫌于1938年1月19日在三宝垄盗窃钻石而被捕。

他持有两本护照（波兰和捷克斯洛伐克），据其称均为伪造。

在受审期间，他透露其真名为 VLADIMIR ILICH MALKOFF，现年25岁，1912年8月5日出生于布拉戈维申斯克（西伯利亚）。他于1921年与其母亲及兄弟从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨。

1922年至1931年间，他居住在哈尔滨和上海，随后前往广州。

1933年或1934年，他因小店盗窃案被香港警方逮捕，并被驱逐出香港，为期十年。

从巴达维亚邮局警方查获的信件之一中显示，他收到来自上海一名名为 Schoers 的人的邮件。据“Malkoff”陈述，此人是其兄弟，与上海警方有联系。信中提及 Schoers 经常访问业余无线电台 XU 8 RB，并请求其兄弟与爪哇的一名无线电爱好者建立联系，以便彼此通信。

如蒙告知信中所提人员是否曾进入上海警方的视线，本人将不胜感激。
